decision.title: Loving You
tracklist: Got a Lot O' Livin' to Do!
Have I Told You Lately That I Love You?

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (12 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/1841133-Elvis-Presley-Loving-You, https://www.theingroove.com/products/elvis-presley-loving-you-lp. US 12-track LP RCA Victor LPM 1515 (July 1957). The UK got a 10-inch 8-track variant. Duplicates noted elsewhere: 'Don't Leave Me Now' also appears on the Jailhouse Rock EP (different 1957 re-recording for that film).
